Commentary.Commentary: Adam Zampa was the pick of the bowlers with his controlled spin bowling and bagged 3 for 38 in his full quota of overs. The Australian seamers were impressive and Starc, Hastings and Faulkner took two wickets a piece. They never allowed the Sri Lankans to settle down and put the brakes on their stroke play. Will the Australians chase down this tricky total or will the Sri Lankan spinners rule the roost again? Join us after the innings break to find out!

Sri Lanka have bounced back well on the back of Chandimal's century and posted a competitive total of 226 on the board. It was a spirited effort from the Australian bowlers as they bowled their hearts out. Chandimal batted with intelligence when wickets were constantly falling at the other end. He maneuvered the field beautifully and completed his 4th ODI ton.

Full around off, Dilshan plays it hesitantly back towards the bowler.
Full outside off, Dilshan pushes it gently towards mid off this time.
Full and wide outside off, moving away. Dilshan has a go at it and misses it completely. Good ball from Hazlewood!
Kusal Mendis is the new batsman. Josh Hazlewood to bowl from the other end!

OUT! Starc strikes in style! On a good length just outside off, Gunathilaka is hesitant in his defence and gets a thick inside edge and the ball crashes into the stumps. Loose from him and he pays the price for it!
Straying down leg, Gunathilaka works it through square leg for a couple.
In the corridor of uncertainty, gets a bit of extra bounce. Dilshan fends it through the slip cordon for a single.
On a length around off, Gunathilaka pushes it with soft hands towards mid on and comes through for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Gunathilaka is careful and lets it go through.
Full ball directed on the pads, Gunathilaka works it down to fine leg for a couple.

The entire Sri Lanka team welcome Dilshan into the ground with their bats raised high. The veteran has been a legend for Sri Lanka and he will like to retire in style! The players are out in the middle. Mitchell Starc to start the proceedings for Australia. Gunathalika will face the first ball.
Team Changes for Australia - Shaun Marsh comes in for Smith, Hastings comes in for Henriques and Hazlewood replaces Lyon.
SRI LANKA WIN THE TOSS AND DECIDE TO BAT FIRST. They would be high on confidence on the back of an emphatic win and name an unchanged side for this one.

Australia on the other hand will be under their new captain David Warner as Smith has been called back to take rest ahead of their tour to South Africa. So, it's all about the double D's on this exciting Sunday afternoon. David to lead the side, Dilshan to say goodbye. Plenty to look forward. Toss coming up in a while.

Apart from this, the onus will be on the veteran Tillakaratne Dilshan who will be seen for the final time in the coloured outfit. He will look to bid adieu to the cricketing arena by playing a knock to treasure forever.

Hello and a warm welcome for the 3rd ODI between Sri Lanka and Australia in Dambulla. The series is poised 1-1 at the moment and this will be the crucial game for either sides. A win will boost their morale and a loss will mean that the side will have to win both to bag the series.
